domains.result: No HTTP response, so no redirect target. Chromium returned net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED and the page reads "This site can't be reached - Check if there is a typo in advancehomereno.com - DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN". A plain fetch fails with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND. Re-tested 2026-11-13. The desktop and phone-width screenshots of the identical error were captured at the www host (see next entry).

Re-tested 2026-11-13: ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED, page text "This site can't be reached ... DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN" at 1280 px and again at 390 px phone width. No page, no certificate warning and no redirect, because the name returns no address. This is the exact host the WiserMap listing links to.

links_to_broken_domain.place: Google Business Profile / Maps place page - website field reads 'advancehomereno.com'
WiserMap business listing - its 'Website' link points to https://www.advancehomereno.com/

likely_cause.cause: lapsed and not re-registered (expired, now client-hold and pending-delete at the original registrar; no sign anyone else has taken it)
likely_cause.reasoning: The public record for advancehomereno.com, read on 2026-11-13, shows registration 2023-08-29, expiry 2026-08-29, last changed 2026-11-10, statuses 'client hold', 'client transfer prohibited' and 'pending delete', still on Google Cloud nameservers. ICANN's status glossary says clientHold means the domain is not activated in the DNS and will not resolve, and that pendingDelete (without redemptionPeriod or pendingRestore alongside it) means the name has already been through the 30-day redemption window and will be purged and dropped from the registry after several days. That sequence - expiry, then grace and redemption, then pending delete - is the pattern of an unrenewed registration rather than a hijack, a parking operator or injected spam; nothing in the record points to a third party. Wayback captures show a genuine business site on the domain on 16 January and 13 February 2026 (the 2024 captures are 403 responses and the July 2025 capture is a 301), so the name was in the business's own use while it worked. Why the renewal was missed is not stated anywhere we could read.

fix_steps.step: Log in at Squarespace Domains (the registrar named in the public record for the domain) and ask today whether advancehomereno.com can still be renewed or restored. ICANN advises contacting the registrar immediately if you want to keep a name carrying the pending-delete status.
fix_steps.who: Owner (needs the account and email used for the domain)

fix_steps.step: If it cannot be restored, either back-order or re-register advancehomereno.com when it drops, or register a new .com the same day. Decide once, and stop linking to the old name until it answers again.
fix_steps.who: Owner, with whoever manages the website

fix_steps.step: Point the domain at a working site: reconnect the existing builder site if that account still holds the pages, or rebuild a small site - home, services, gallery, contact - with a tap-to-call button and a short quote form, both of which the archived site had.

Update the Google Business Profile website field to the working address (or clear it until one exists), and add a description and photos. Then correct the WiserMap listing through its own suggest/edit route.
fix_steps.who: Owner for the Google profile (must be signed in to the Google account linked to the profile); the web person supplies the wording

fix_steps.step: Set registrar auto-renew on a card that does not expire, and put a calendar reminder or a free uptime check on the domain so a dead site is noticed within days rather than months.

after_fix.opportunity: Fill in the Google profile itself: add project photos and a business description, then invite recent customers to leave reviews so the 5.0 rating has visible detail behind it.

# Website Health Check: Advance Home Renovations LLC

**What we saw on 13 November 2026**

- The Google profile (5.0, "General contractor", New Brunswick, NJ, (973) 905-2129) lists advancehomereno.com as its website. The domain does not resolve in a browser at desktop or phone width: "This site can't be reached - DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN".
- The public record for the domain shows it expired on 29 August 2026 and now carries "client hold" and "pending delete" at Squarespace Domains II LLC; ICANN's glossary says such a name drops from the registry after several days.
- Snapshots from 13 February 2026 show a small site - home, about, a services page, four service pages and contact - with a (973) 905-2129 call button and a "Get A Free Quote" form. None of it is reachable now.
- The WiserMap directory entry links to the same dead address.

**What it means for customers**

Anyone tapping "Website" on Google or WiserMap lands on a browser error and cannot see services, photos or a quote form. The profile and phone number still work, so calling is the practical route.

**How to fix it**

1. Log in at Squarespace Domains (the registrar on the public record) and ask whether the name can be renewed or restored - 0.5-1 h, owner.
2. If not, re-register it when it drops or pick a new .com; stop linking to the old address - 1-2 h plus waiting, owner.
3. Rebuild a small site (home, services, gallery, contact) with tap-to-call and a quote form - 4-8 h, web developer.
4. Change the website field on Google and WiserMap - 0.5-1.5 h, owner.
5. Turn on auto-renew and add a reminder or free uptime check - 0.5 h, owner.

**After the fix**

Add project photos and a description to the Google profile and invite recent customers to review, so the 5.0 rating has detail behind it.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.
